in_hebrew.name: Hoeve
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Hoeve הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Old Dutch word 'hof' meaning 'court' or 'yard'. The name Hoeve refers to a farm or an estate. In the Middle Ages, a 'hof' was a large farm with a manor house and outbuildings. It was the center of a community and provided for the needs of its inhabitants.
